claimText: When assigning the final heading to intercept the final approach course or track, the runway shall be confirmed, and the aircraft shall be advised of its position relative to a fix on the final approach course or track, the altitude to be maintained until established on the final approach course or track, to the glide path or vertical path intercept point, and if required, clearance for the appropriate approach.
rationale: Attempts 1 and 2 bundle these as a single workflow constraint. Attempt 3 splits them. Preference is given to bundling because the advisory items are simultaneous requirements triggered by a single event (assigning final heading).
